messages.author: c8fe4075ec631c03
messages.subject: apache clustering and session ID
parts:
Hi,

  I use shiny server and apache to proxy it.

  has anyone solved the problem of clustering?  if so, can you give an example of how to configure it in apache?

-Alex

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: apache clustering and session ID
parts:
I haven't tried it but you should be able to use cookie based stickiness (where the cookie is generated by the load balancer itself).

For example if you are using Apache itself as the load balancer, then here is how you would do it:
http://httpd.apache.org/docs/2.4/mod/mod_proxy_balancer.html#example
(See the second example)

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: apache clustering and session ID
parts: That should be OK. Shiny Server uses SockJS, which will try to use websockets first but also knows how to use regular HTTP requests if necessary.
